# Vendored Go PBKDF2

Unmodified `golang.org/x/crypto/pbkdf2`, tag `v0.31.0` (BSD-3-Clause).
Source: https://github.com/golang/crypto/blob/v0.31.0/pbkdf2/pbkdf2.go
Git blob SHA-1: `28cd99c7f3fc50b03f3789b1013401db46d40bf9`.
License blob: `2a7cf70da6e498df9c11ab6a5eaa2ddd7af34da4`.

Only this dependency-free primitive is vendored, to support offline Go 1.23+
builds. This is not a claim that the entire old x/crypto module is included or
that it is the latest version. The password policy/encoding is in secure/password.go.
